'''2009 Bespin Regionals Brian Stenger DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Stenger]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
